title: Generation of mixed murine organoids to model cellular interactions
author: Krotenberg Garcia, van Rheenen, et al.
materials: Cultrex PathClear Reduced Growth Factor Basement Membrane Extract Type 2

steps.title: Prepare matrix and reagents
steps.instruction: Thaw Reduced Growth Factor Basement Membrane Extract Type 2 (BME2) on ice or in a refrigerator overnight; incubate untreated polystyrene 6‑, 12‑, and 24‑well plates at 37 °C for at least 48 h before use to promote BME2 droplet formation; prepare all buffers and media according to the Materials and Equipment tables; fire‑polish a glass Pasteur pipet for each culture (spares recommended) by briefly placing the tip in a Bunsen‑flame while rolling; cool all centrifuges to 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Thaw BME2 on ice or in fridge overnight.
Prepare buffers and media as listed.
Fire‑polish one glass Pasteur pipet per culture.

steps.title: Harvest organoids on ice
steps.instruction: Scrape the bottom of each well and pipette up‑and‑down with a p1000 using ice‑cold Basic culture medium; collect the suspension in 15 mL centrifuge tubes on ice; optionally wash the well with an additional 1 mL ice‑cold Basic medium and add the wash to the tube; centrifuge at 300 × g, 4 °C for 5 min, forming three layers (medium, BME2, pellet); carefully remove the medium and BME2 layers without disturbing the pellet; resuspend the organoid pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold Basic culture medium.

substeps.instruction: Scrape and pipette organoids with ice‑cold Basic medium.
Collect suspension in 15 mL tubes on ice.
Optional: wash well with 1 mL ice‑cold Basic medium and add to tube.
Remove medium and BME2 layers carefully.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL ice‑cold Basic medium.

steps.title: Aspirate medium before fixation
steps.instruction: Carefully aspirate culture medium without disturbing the BME2 drop or the monolayer.

steps.title: Fix organoids
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL fixation solution to each well and incubate at room temperature for 20 min (extend up to 30 min if the BME2 drop is not fully dissolved); aspirate the fixation solution once the BME2 drop is completely dissolved; wash twice with 100 µL PBS.

substeps.instruction: Incubate RT 20 min (up to 30 min if needed).
Aspirate fixation solution after BME2 dissolution.

steps.title: Store fixed organoids (optional)
steps.instruction: Fixed organoids may be stored in PBS protected from light at 4 °C for 2–3 weeks before proceeding with immunostaining.

steps.title: Block and permeabilize
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL blocking solution and incubate at room temperature for at least 30 min (the step can be prolonged for several hours if convenient).

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute the appropriate primary antibodies in Antibody incubation solution, add 50 µL per well, and incubate at 4 °C protected from light overnight (8–16 h) or up to several days.

steps.title: Wash after primary
steps.instruction: Wash three times with 100 µL washing solution, 5 min each, at room temperature.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute the appropriate secondary antibodies (and optional DAPI or phalloidin) in Antibody incubation solution, add 50 µL per well, and incubate at room temperature protected from light for at least 1 h (the step can be prolonged up to several days; if incubation exceeds 5 h, perform it at 4 °C).

steps.title: Wash after secondary
steps.instruction: Wash three times with 100 µL washing solution, 5 min each, at room temperature.

steps.title: Final rinse and storage
steps.instruction: Rinse twice with 100 µL PBS and leave organoids in PBS; stained organoids can be stored in the dark at 4 °C for up to one week—ensure they do not dry out by adding enough PBS or sealing plates with parafilm.

steps.title: Image organoids
steps.instruction: Image using a confocal platform with a high‑NA 20–25× objective; acquire Z‑stacks (5 µm slice thickness for 3D mixed organoids, or cover ~20 µm for enteroid monolayers).
